scripts.dev: npm run kill:3002 && npm run clean && next dev -p 3002
scripts.kill:3002: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3002 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($conn) { Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force; Write-Output ('Killed PID ' + $conn.OwningProcess + ' on port 3002') } else { Write-Output 'Port 3002 already free' }"
scripts.dev:reset: npm run kill:3002 && npm run clean && npm run dev
scripts.clean: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; if (Test-Path .next) { Remove-Item .next\* -Recurse -Force; Remove-Item .next -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path node_modules/.cache) { Remove-Item node_modules/.cache -Recurse -Force }"
